newsitem.title: USA: Provident, Paul Revere delay deal.
newsitem.headline: Provident, Paul Revere delay deal.

text.p: Provident Cos Inc and Paul Revere Corp said on Monday that they are experiencing a delay in Provident's $1.2 billion acquisition of Paul Revere announced in April.
The companies said in a joint statement they hope to close in the fourth quarter, instead of the third quarter.

The delay is primarily due to Paul Revere studying its individual disability reserves and the companies to address related issues in the review process for the joint proxy statement being prepared for shareholder votes, the companies said.
Delaware, New York and Tennessee regulators granted approvals of the deal, but it still is awaiting regulatory approval in Massachusetts, the companies said.
Paul Revere is 83-percent owned by Textron Inc.
